# Frozen probability parameters

`catalogs/vclust_flank_models.3469834.json` contains the numerical MODEL_REF and
MODEL_VC arrays extracted from PacificBiosciences/vclust, commit
`3469834d53106ba97734b3f317dd0605c8e65e78`, `src/models.rs`.
The source URL, commit and SHA256 are recorded in that JSON. The upstream
LICENSE.md is preserved here unchanged; this parameter file is not relicensed
under any license of this project. No vclust executable or source code is used
for read placement. The probability parameters are used only with the four
PacBio HiFi discovery samples. Frozen coordinates are then applied by the
independently implemented affine locator.

Source: https://github.com/PacificBiosciences/vclust/blob/3469834d53106ba97734b3f317dd0605c8e65e78/src/models.rs

License: https://github.com/PacificBiosciences/vclust/blob/3469834d53106ba97734b3f317dd0605c8e65e78/LICENSE.md

This task keeps the implementation in a local server branch. Redistribution of
upstream material is outside this task; preserve and review its original terms
before any separate publication.
